newsitem.title: ECUADOR: ECUADOR JUNE FOREIGN DEBT UP 1.1 PCT VS YEAR AGO.
newsitem.headline: ECUADOR JUNE FOREIGN DEBT UP 1.1 PCT VS YEAR AGO.

text.p: Ecuador's foreign debt stood at $12.563 billion in June, up 1.1 percent from the same month a year earlier, the central bank said Tuesday.
The figure, which includes delayed interest payments, compares with $12.426 billion in June 1996 and $12.543 billion in May this year.
Total foreign public-sector debt stood at 64.8 percent of gross domestic product in June, the central bank said in a statement.
Meanwhile, total private sector foreign debt was at $2 billion in June, up 7.56 percent from the same month a year earlier when it stood at $1.86 billion.
